message: Graded the same day, posted the next. The teachers at Ryuusei Academy work fast.
As much as I'd love to tell them not to handle my fate so lightly--

name: Synn
message: 「I just have to steel myself here. Screw it, here goes!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaat, is that all? Don't scare me like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you so much! It's all thanks to you, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, that's not true at all. This is genuinely your own ability, Synn-kun. I always knew... you could do it if you tried.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And in 2nd place, too. You worked really hard~, there, there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sometimes you have to look away from reality, you know!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once it's over and done with, I forget everything. Tests? Never heard of 'em~」
With this, my academy life is safe and sound for the time being.
